page_title: CurlShot - Take a screenshot of any website, online or by API

sources.entry: CurlShot - Screenshot API that captures any URL, HTML, or Markdown as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, or scrolling video, with a hosted MCP server so AI agents can take screenshots. Free plan with 100 screenshots/month. #freemium #api #mcp

summary.name: CurlShot
summary.one_liner: CurlShot is a web-based tool and screenshot API that captures full-page screenshots of any website as an image or PDF, with no installation needed.
use_cases: Save a record of a web page's appearance, such as prices or terms
Check how a website looks on phone or tablet
Convert web articles or reports to printable PDFs
Add site thumbnails to directories or link lists
Generate social share images for pages
Automate screenshots via API for many URLs
summary.what_it_does: CurlShot takes a screenshot of a web page given its address, opening it in a browser-like environment. It can capture the whole page from top to bottom, or just the top, rendered as a computer, phone, or tablet would show it. Output is PNG, JPEG, WebP, or a paper-sized PDF. It attempts to hide ads, cookie pop-ups, and chat bubbles. The same capability is offered as an HTTP screenshot API, plus a hosted MCP server with a take_screenshot tool for AI agents.
notable: Hosted MCP server with take_screenshot tool for AI agents
Accepts URLs, HTML, or Markdown and returns PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF
Signed links allow embedding screenshot URLs without exposing the API key
Failed screenshots do not count toward the monthly quota
caveats: Pages behind a login show the login screen unless cookies or headers are supplied
Local and private addresses are refused; HTML must be sent directly instead
Ad and cookie pop-up removal is not guaranteed on every site
Free plan is limited to 100 screenshots per month; paid plans start at $19 a month
